scripts.title: XeonHub
scripts.features:
This script is an open source script and there is only 1 rule in it, it is not to pass this script off as your own, but this only works if you take the script itself and say you made it if you take some function from the script I won't mind. Enjoy my script. ^_^
Also, here's a link to the current state of the experiments. You can write a comment there or ask for a script for another experience in English: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YrScPheOvwaZSd4jHvIfwsf7NlaiXtib2a12ZZ3kpxc/edit?usp=sharing
Here's the Russian version:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-PP0TaU9Yot_3ixky4hdsj-iwFzoOyIkEm0JfsZjku4/edit?usp=sharing
